tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// dpal kye'i rdo rje'i bstod pa daṇḍa ka zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// bdag gis thal mo spyir sbyar nas// dang bas bla ma la btud de// dpal ldan kye yi rdo rje la// sdeb sbyor daṇḍa kas bstod bgyi// nyi ma dang ni sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ yig las bsgrubs rdo rje'i sa dang rwa ba drwa ba gur dang bla re 'bar ba'i me yi nang du phyogs bdag zhing skyong lto 'phye'i dbang po mchod rten chu dang me dang chu 'dzin dang ni 'dre dang srin po mkha' 'gro dang ni mkha' 'gro ma dang ro langs ro dang ro ni mdung gis phub dang dum bu dang ni tshil dang klad pa ser skya lug cing khrag dang skra yi dum dang de dag 'thor dang rus pas gang zhing keng rus gar byed ce spyang phaiṃ zhes sgrogs shing bya yi tshogs kyis gang ba'i khrod na rnal 'byor ma dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshogs kyis gang ba'i dbus su chos kyi 'byung gnas dmar skya'i mdog can gdengs kha gyen du phyogs pa'i nang na thar pa chen po'i grong khyer ye shes lnga yi rin chen las grub gru bzhi dang ni sgo bzhis mdzes shing rin chen ka ba rdo rje'i gdung dang rta babs ri dwags chos kyi 'khor lo gdugs dang bcas shing pha gu mda' yab rin chen du ma'i drwa ba dang ni drwa ba phyed pa zla ba rlung gis bskyod dang me tog phreng ba dril bu dang ni g.yer ka'i phreng dang rgyal mtshan che dang ba dan mdzes bcas rnga yab dar gyi lda ldis brgyan la mchod snam steng na lha mo'i tshogs rnams mchod rdzas du mas lag brel mdzes pa'i rgyan can 'dzum pa'i bzhin dang glu yi dbyangs can zur mig lta dang bcas pa du mas gang zhing pho brang rtse mor rdo rje dang ni nor bu rin chen las bsgrubs ches mtho mdzes pa'i dbus su sna tshogs padma'i lte bar gdong bzhi dang ni dbang po dang bcas 'jug sel dag dang drag po rnams ni rtabs shing 'gyel la lag cha shor nas thal mo sbyar zhing gdong gis gyen du lta ba rnams kyi snying ga'i steng du tsha zer can gyi dbus na bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan rab dgyes srid zhi mnyam par 'joms pa de ni chos nyid rang bzhin nam mkha'i mdog dang cung zad char sprin mdog la utpal sngo dang baiḍūrya ltar sngo la rnam thar rang bzhin zhal brgyad pa ste g.yas ni chu shel mdog la padma rā ga'i mdog tu g.yon pa snang zhing lhag ma rnams ni du ba'i mdog la ral pa dmar ser gyen du langs shing zhal rnams re rer spyan gsum dmar la zla phyed 'dra ba'i mche bas bdud rnams skrag mdzad stong nyid ngo bo drug lhag bcu yi phyag na btung ba'i snod mchog zla ba rgyas pa zil gnon lta bur dkar ba'i nang na gnyis 'thung myur 'gro sgra chen khyu mchog mgrin rings mi dang ri dwags rgyal po byi la rnams ni g.yas yin gcig shos rnams na gzhi dang rlan byed gnas med drod dang ri bong can dang nyin mor byed pa mthar byed dang ni nor gyi bdag po 'dzin cing bsdu dngos rang bzhin zhabs bzhi'i gar gyi brjid kyis sa gzhi grum nas bying ba'i stobs kyis rgya mtsho 'khrugs nas gyen du bskyod pa'i rba rlabs 'thor zhing srid pa gsum po g.yo bar mdzad pa'i rang bzhin can la thal chen gyis byugs sku de'i rgyan ni kha ba dung dang ku mu ta ltar dkar ba'i mi rus phreng dang mi mgo'i cod pan khrag 'dzag mgo phreng do shal bcas shing rgyu ma'i lda ldis brgyan la sna tshogs rdo rjes dbu steng mdzes shing dril bu dang ni dril bu g.yer ka rin chen mchog dang dug sbrul gdengs ka dang bcas 'jigs pa'i lce brkyang drag po'i phud sgra dang bcas la sogs du mas brgyan byas stag lpags dang ni mi yi pags pas snam dkris ha ha hi hi la sogs 'jigs pa'i bzhed sgra drag pos dregs pa can rnams btul zhing brlag par mdzad nas slar yang gso bar mdzad la nyams dgu dang ni ldan pa'i bcom ldan bde ba chen po'i ye shes rang bzhin nyid la dbyings kyi rang bzhin rdo rje bdag med ma dpal dag dang gnyis min gnyis ni spangs shing gnyis med ngo bo gang yin de ni lha mo'i tshogs kyi dbus na bzhugs shing 'gro ba ma lus pa rnams srid pa'i 'jigs dang mya ngan 'das pa'i 'jigs pa rnams las skyob par mdzad pa'i he ru ka dpal mgon po du mar snang zhing rang bzhin gnyis med de yi zhabs la bdag ni rtag tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo//

༈ //gang zhig he ru ka yi bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di/ 'gro ba gang zhig 'dzin nam bstod par byed kyang rung*// nyan nam cung zhig sems par byed pa de dag ni// gsang ba gsum bdag he ru ka dang mnyam par 'gyur// dus dgra'i rdo rje sems dpa' la// rgyun chags zhes bya'i sdeb sbyor du// bsdebs pa'i bstod pa'i rgyal po 'di// grags pa rgyal mtshan bdag gis bgyis// 'di bgyis pa las ngal bar gyur pa yi// dge ba dri med gangs ri ltar dkar ba// bdag gi rgyud la skyes pa de dag gis// 'gro kun dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin 'gyur shog /rgyun chags shing 'gran zla med pa'i bstod pa zhes bya ba bstod pa dngos la yi ge bdun brgya bdun cu rtsa bdun bgyis so// shākya'i dge bsnyen grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis nye bar sbyar ba 'di yongs su rdzogs so// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
